translations.literal: General of Pacifying the North Xiao Yingda, Friend of the Prince of Nankang, commands thirty thousand tiger troops to display might in the rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: : Xiao Yingda, General of Pacifying the North and Friend of the Prince of Nankang, commands thirty thousand tiger troops as a rearguard of strength.

sentences.zh: 蕭雍州勳業蓋世，謀猷淵肅，旣痛家禍，兼憤國難，泣血枕戈，誓雪怨酷，精卒十萬，已出漢川。

translations.literal: Lord Xiao of Yong province—his merit covers the age, his plans deep and solemn; having grieved family calamity, he also burns with national outrage; weeping blood he pillows on his spear, swearing to wash away bitter wrong; a hundred thousand picked troops have already marched out from the Han River.
translations.idiomatic: : Lord Xiao of Yong province—his merit covers the age and his counsel is deep and grave; grieving family calamity and burning with national outrage, he weeps blood and pillows on his spear, swearing to avenge bitter wrongs; a hundred thousand picked troops have already marched from the Han.

sentences.zh: 張郢州節義慷慨，悉力齊奮。

translations.literal: Zhang of Ying province is lofty in integrity and generous in righteousness, exerting all his strength in united zeal.
translations.idiomatic: : Zhang of Ying province is lofty in integrity and generous in spirit, exerting all his strength in common cause.

sentences.zh: 江州邵陵王、湘州張行事、王司州皆遠近懸契，不謀而同，竝勒驍猛，指景風驅。

translations.literal: The Prince of Shaoling in Jiang province, Zhang the Acting Governor of Xiang province, and Wang of Si province—all bound in distant covenant, alike without prior counsel, together drive the fierce and valiant, pointing with the scene-wind in chase.
translations.idiomatic: : The Prince of Shaoling in Jiang province, Zhang the Acting Governor of Xiang province, and Wang of Si province—all bound in distant alliance, alike without prior counsel, together drive the fierce and valiant forward.

sentences.zh: 舟艦魚麗，萬里蓋水，車騎雲屯，平原霧塞。

translations.literal: Warships array like fish scales, ten thousand li covering the water; chariots and horsemen cloud-massed, the plain mist-sealed.
translations.idiomatic: : Warships array like fish scales and cover the waters for ten thousand li; chariots and horsemen mass like clouds and seal the plain in mist.

sentences.zh: 以同心之士，伐倒戈之衆，盛德之師，救危亡之國，何征而不服，何誅而不克哉！

translations.literal: With men of one heart to attack a multitude that has turned its spears, with an army of supreme virtue to rescue a state in peril of death—what campaign would not submit, what execution would not succeed!
translations.idiomatic: With men of one heart attacking troops who have turned their spears, with an army of supreme virtue rescuing a state near death—what campaign would fail to conquer, what foe would fail to fall!

sentences.zh: :　　今兵之所指，唯在梅蟲兒、茹法珍二人而已。

translations.literal: : Now where the army points, it is only at Mei Chong'er and Ru Fazhen, these two men.
translations.idiomatic: : Now where the army points, it is only at Mei Chong'er and Ru Fazhen.

sentences.zh: 諸君德載累世，勳著先朝，屬無妄之時，居道消之運，受迫羣豎，念有危懼。

translations.literal: You gentlemen bear virtue through accumulated generations and merit shining in the former court; you meet a time without cause and dwell in an era when the Way declines, pressed by groups of lads and mindful of peril and fear.
translations.idiomatic: : You gentlemen bear virtue through generations and merit renowned in the former court; you meet an unmerited time and dwell in an era of declining Way, pressed by base lads and mindful of peril.

sentences.zh: 大軍近次，當各思拔迹，來赴軍門。

translations.literal: The great army draws near—each of you should think to clear your tracks and come to the army gate.
translations.idiomatic: : The great army draws near—each of you should clear your path and come to the army gate.

sentences.zh: 檄到之日，有能斬送蟲兒、法珍首者，封二千戶開國縣侯。

translations.literal: On the day this proclamation arrives, whoever can behead and deliver the heads of Chong'er and Fazhen shall be enfeoffed as Marquis of an Opening County with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: : On the day this proclamation arrives, whoever can behead and deliver the heads of Chong'er and Fazhen shall be enfeoffed as Opening Marquis of a county with two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 若迷惑凶黨，敢拒軍鋒，刑茲無赦，戮及宗族。

translations.literal: If deluded by the wicked faction you dare resist the army's edge, punishment shall be without pardon and slaughter shall reach your clan.
translations.idiomatic: : If deluded by the wicked faction you dare resist the army's edge, punishment shall be without pardon and slaughter shall reach your clans.

sentences.zh: 賞罰之信，有如曒日，江水在此，余不食言。

translations.literal: The trust of reward and punishment is like the bright sun; the Yangzi River is here—I shall not eat my words.
translations.idiomatic: : The trust of reward and punishment is bright as the sun; as the Yangzi is here, I shall not break my word.

sentences.zh: 遣冠軍將軍楊公則向湘州。

translations.literal: General of the Champion Yang Gongze was sent toward Xiang province.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Champion Yang Gongze was sent toward Xiang province.

sentences.zh: 王法度不進軍，免官。

translations.literal: Wang Fadu did not advance his army and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fadu did not advance his army and was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 公則進剋巴陵，仍向湘州。

translations.literal: Gongze advanced and took Baling, then continued toward Xiang province.
translations.idiomatic: Gongze advanced, took Baling, and continued toward Xiang province.

sentences.zh: 遣寧朔將軍劉坦行湘州事。

translations.literal: General of Pacifying the North Liu Tan was sent to act in Xiang province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tan, General of Pacifying the North, was sent to handle Xiang province affairs.

sentences.zh: 穎冑遣人謂梁王曰：「時月未利，當須來年二月。

translations.literal: Yingzhou sent a man to tell the Prince of Liang: "The months and seasons are not yet favorable; we must wait until the second month of next year.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou sent word to the Prince of Liang: "The season is not yet favorable; we should wait until the second month of next year.

sentences.zh: 今便進兵，恐非良策。

translations.literal: If we advance the army now, I fear it is not a good plan.
translations.idiomatic: If we advance the army now, I fear it is not a good plan.

sentences.zh: 」梁王曰：「今坐甲十萬，糧用自竭。

translations.literal: " The Prince of Liang said: "Now we sit with an army of a hundred thousand and provisions are self-exhausting.
translations.idiomatic: " The Prince of Liang said: "We now sit with an army of a hundred thousand and our provisions are exhausting themselves.

sentences.zh: 況藉以義心，一時驍銳。

translations.literal: Moreover we rely on righteous hearts and momentary fierce sharpness.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover we rely on righteous hearts and momentary fierce valor.

sentences.zh: 且太白出西方，杖義而動，天時人謀，無有不利。

translations.literal: Moreover the Great White star has come out in the west; moving with righteousness, in Heaven's season and men's counsel, nothing is unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Great White star has risen in the west; acting with righteousness, in Heaven's season and men's counsel, nothing is unfavorable.

sentences.zh: 昔武王伐紂，行逆太歲，豈復待年月邪？

translations.literal: Of old King Wu attacked Zhou, marching against the Grand Year star—must he still wait for months and years?
translations.idiomatic: Of old King Wu attacked Zhou while marching against the Grand Year star—did he wait for the calendar to turn?

sentences.zh: 」穎冑乃從。

translations.literal: " Yingzhou then followed.
translations.idiomatic: " Yingzhou then agreed.

sentences.zh: 遣西中郎參軍鄧元起率衆向夏口。

translations.literal: He sent Deng Yuanqi, Aide of the West Central Commandant, to lead troops toward Xiakou.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Deng Yuanqi, Aide of the West Central Commandant, to lead troops toward Xiakou.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，和帝爲相國，穎冑領左長史，進號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Prince He became Prince of the State; Yingzhou was Chief Clerk on the left and his title was advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year Prince He became Prince of the State; Yingzhou served as Chief Clerk on the left and was promoted to General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 於是始選用方伯。

translations.literal: Then for the first time regional inspectors were selected and appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Then for the first time regional inspectors were selected and appointed.

sentences.zh: 梁王屢表勸和帝卽尊號，梁州刺史柳惔、竟陵太守曹景宗竝勸進。

translations.literal: The Prince of Liang repeatedly memorialized urging Prince He to ascend the exalted title; Liu Yan, Inspector of Liang province, and Cao Jingzong, Administrator of Jingling, both urged his advancement.
translations.idiomatic: : The Prince of Liang repeatedly memorialized urging Prince He to take the throne; Liu Yan, Inspector of Liang province, and Cao Jingzong, Administrator of Jingling, both urged him forward.

sentences.zh: 穎冑使別駕宗夬撰定禮儀，上尊號，改元，於江陵立宗廟、南北郊，州府城門悉依建康宮，置尚書五省，以城南射堂爲蘭臺，南郡太守爲尹。

translations.literal: Yingzhou had Assisting Officer Zong Jue compile and fix the ritual ceremonies, present the exalted title, change the era name, establish ancestral temples and southern and northern suburban altars at Jiangling, make all prefectural and headquarters city gates follow the Jiankang palace pattern, set up the Five Departments of the Masters of Writing, use the southern shooting hall as the Orchid Terrace, and make the Administrator of Nan commandery the Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingzhou had Assisting Officer Zong Jue compile the rituals, present the exalted title, change the era name, establish ancestral temples and suburban altars at Jiangling, model prefectural gates on the Jiankang palace, set up the Five Departments of the Masters of Writing, use the southern shooting hall as the Orchid Terrace, and make the Administrator of Nan commandery the Intendant.

sentences.zh: 建武中，荊州大風雨，龍入柏齋中，柱壁上有爪足處，刺史蕭遙欣恐畏，不敢居之。

translations.literal: During the Jianwu era a great wind and rain struck Jing province; a dragon entered the cypress study hall, and on pillars and walls were places of claw and foot—Inspector Xiao Yaoxin was afraid and did not dare dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianwu era a great storm struck Jing province; a dragon entered the cypress study hall, leaving claw marks on pillars and walls—Inspector Xiao Yaoxin was afraid and would not live there.

sentences.zh: 至是以爲嘉祐殿。

translations.literal: Now it was made the Hall of Auspicious Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: It was now renamed the Hall of Auspicious Blessing.

sentences.zh: 中興元年三月，穎冑爲侍中、尚書令，假節、都督如故。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Zhongxing, Yingzhou was Palace Attendant and Minister Over the Masters of Writing, Bearer of the Staff and Supervisor as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Zhongxing, Yingzhou was Palace Attendant and Minister Over the Masters of Writing, retaining the staff and supervisory posts.

sentences.zh: 尋領吏部尚書，監八州軍事，行荊州刺史，本官如故。

translations.literal: Soon he concurrently served as Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, supervised military affairs in eight provinces, and acted in Jingzhou affairs, his original offices as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he also served as Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, supervised military affairs in eight provinces, and acted as Inspector of Jingzhou while retaining his existing posts.

sentences.zh: 左丞樂藹奏曰：「敕旨以軍旅務殷，且停朝直。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Yue Ai memorialized: "By edict, because military affairs are pressing, court attendance is for the moment suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Yue Ai memorialized: "By edict, because military affairs are pressing, regular court attendance is suspended.

sentences.zh: 竊謂匪懈于位，義昭夙興，國容舊典，不可頓闕。

translations.literal: I humbly consider that untiring diligence in office is righteousness made manifest from early rising; the state's ceremonial forms and old statutes cannot suddenly be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: I consider that untiring diligence in office is the righteousness of early rising made manifest; the state's ceremonial forms cannot suddenly be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 與兼右丞江詮等參議，八座丞郎以下宜五日一朝，有事郎坐侍下鼓，無事許從實還外。

translations.literal: Consulting with Concurrent Right Assistant Jiang Quan and others, from the eight seat-holders and gentleman-attendants downward they should attend court once every five days; when there is business the gentleman-attendants should sit in attendance until the lower drum; when there is none they may according to fact return outside.
translations.idiomatic: Consulting with Concurrent Right Assistant Jiang Quan and others, we propose that from the eight seat-holders and gentleman-attendants downward they attend once every five days; when there is business the gentleman-attendants remain until the lower drum; when there is none they may return.

sentences.zh: 」奏可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 梁王義師出沔口，郢州刺史張沖據城拒守。

translations.literal: The Prince of Liang's righteous army issued from the Mian mouth; Zhang Chong, Inspector of Ying province, held the city and resisted.
translations.idiomatic: : The Prince of Liang's righteous army issued from the Han mouth; Zhang Chong, Inspector of Ying province, held the city and resisted.

sentences.zh: 楊公則定湘州，行事張寶積送江陵，率軍會夏口。

translations.literal: Yang Gongze settled Xiang province; Acting Governor Zhang Baoji was sent to Jiangling, and he led his army to join at Xiakou.
translations.idiomatic: : Yang Gongze settled Xiang province; Acting Governor Zhang Baoji was sent to Jiangling, and he led his army to join at Xiakou.

sentences.zh: 巴西太守魯休烈、巴東太守蕭惠訓遣子璝拒義師。

translations.literal: Lu Xiulie, Administrator of Baxi, and Xiao Huixun, Administrator of Badong, sent the son Gui to resist the righteous army.
translations.idiomatic: : Lu Xiulie, Administrator of Baxi, and Xiao Huixun, Administrator of Badong, sent the son Gui to resist the righteous army.

sentences.zh: 穎冑遣汶陽太守劉孝慶進峽口，與巴東太守任漾之、宜都太守鄭法紹禦之。

translations.literal: Yingzhou sent Liu Xiaoqing, Administrator of Wenyang, to advance on the gorge mouth, with Ren Yangzhi, Administrator of Badong, and Zheng Fazhao, Administrator of Yidu, to resist.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingzhou sent Liu Xiaoqing, Administrator of Wenyang, to advance on the gorge mouth, with Ren Yangzhi, Administrator of Badong, and Zheng Fazhao, Administrator of Yidu, to resist.

sentences.zh: 時軍旅之際，人情未安，穎冑府長史張熾從絳衫左右三十餘人，入千秋門，城內驚恐，疑有同異。

translations.literal: At a time of military affairs popular feeling was not yet settled; Zhang Chi, Chief Clerk of Yingzhou's headquarters, with more than thirty attendants in deep-red shirts entered the Qianqiu Gate; within the city there was alarm and fear, and suspicion of some ulterior design.
translations.idiomatic: : At a time of military crisis popular feeling was unsettled; Zhang Chi, Chief Clerk of the headquarters, entered Qianqiu Gate with more than thirty attendants in deep-red shirts; the city was alarmed and suspected treachery.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞奏彈熾，詔以贖論。

translations.literal: The Censor-in-chief memorialized to impeach Chi; an edict ordered redemption by payment.
translations.idiomatic: : The Censor-in-chief memorialized to impeach Chi; an edict ordered redemption by payment.

sentences.zh: 穎冑弟穎孚在京師，廬陵人脩靈祐竊將南上，於西昌縣山中聚兵二千人，襲郡，內史謝篹奔豫章。

translations.literal: Yingzhou's younger brother Yingfu was in the capital; Xiu Lingyou of Luling secretly led men southward and in Xichang county mountains gathered two thousand troops, raided the commandery, and the Interior Minister Xie Juan fled to Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingzhou's younger brother Yingfu was in the capital; Xiu Lingyou of Luling secretly led men south, gathered two thousand troops in the mountains of Xichang county, raided the commandery, and Interior Minister Xie Juan fled to Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 穎孚、靈祐據郡求援，穎冑遣寧朔將軍范僧簡入湘州南道援之。

translations.literal: Yingfu and Lingyou held the commandery seeking aid; Yingzhou sent Fan Jian, General of Pacifying the North, into the southern route of Xiang province to rescue them.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingfu and Lingyou held the commandery and sought aid; Yingzhou sent Fan Jian, General of Pacifying the North, by the southern route of Xiang province to rescue them.

sentences.zh: 僧簡進剋安成，仍以爲輔國將軍、安成內史。

translations.literal: Jian advanced and took Ancheng, and was then made General Who Assists the State and Interior Minister of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: : Jian advanced and took Ancheng, then was made General Who Assists the State and Interior Minister of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 拜穎孚爲冠軍將軍、廬陵內史。

translations.literal: Yingfu was appointed General of the Champion and Interior Minister of Luling.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingfu was appointed General of the Champion and Interior Minister of Luling.

sentences.zh: 合二郡兵，出彭蠡口。

translations.literal: Combining the troops of the two commanderies, they issued from Pengli mouth.
translations.idiomatic: : Combining troops from the two commanderies, they issued from Pengli mouth.

sentences.zh: 東昏侯遣軍主彭盆、劉希祖三千人受江州刺史陳伯之節度，南討二郡義兵，仍進取湘州。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Donghun sent army commanders Peng Pen and Liu Xizu with three thousand men under the direction of Chen Bozhi, Inspector of Jiang province, to campaign south against the righteous armies of the two commanderies, and then to advance and take Xiang province.
translations.idiomatic: : The Marquis of Donghun sent army commanders Peng Pen and Liu Xizu with three thousand men under Chen Bozhi, Inspector of Jiang province, to campaign south against the righteous armies of the two commanderies and then advance on Xiang province.

sentences.zh: 南康太守王丹保郡應盆等。

translations.literal: Wang Dan, Administrator of Nankang, held the commandery and responded to Pen and the others.
translations.idiomatic: : Wang Dan, Administrator of Nankang, held the commandery and supported Pen and the others.

sentences.zh: 穎孚聞兵至，望風奔走。

translations.literal: When Yingfu heard the army had come he fled at the wind's report.
translations.idiomatic: : When Yingfu heard the army was coming he fled at once.

sentences.zh: 前內史謝篹復還郡。

translations.literal: The former Interior Minister Xie Juan returned to the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: : Former Interior Minister Xie Juan returned to the commandery.

sentences.zh: 劉希祖至安成，攻戰七日，城陷，范僧簡見殺。

translations.literal: Liu Xizu reached Ancheng; after seven days of attack and battle the city fell and Fan Jian was killed.
translations.idiomatic: : Liu Xizu reached Ancheng; after seven days of fighting the city fell and Fan Jian was killed.

sentences.zh: 希祖仍爲安成內史。

translations.literal: Xizu then became Interior Minister of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: : Xizu then became Interior Minister of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 穎孚收散卒據西昌，謝篹又遣軍攻之，衆敗，奔湘州。

translations.literal: Yingfu gathered scattered troops and held Xichang; Xie Juan again sent troops to attack him; the multitude was defeated and he fled to Xiang province.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingfu gathered scattered troops and held Xichang; Xie Juan again sent troops against him; his forces were defeated and he fled to Xiang province.

sentences.zh: 以穎孚爲督湘東衡陽零陵桂陽營陽五郡、湘東內史，假節、將軍如故。

translations.literal: Yingfu was made Supervisor of the five commanderies Xiangdong, Hengyang, Lingling, Guiyang, and Yingyang, and Interior Minister of Xiangdong, Bearer of the Staff and General as before.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingfu was made Supervisor of Xiangdong, Hengyang, Lingling, Guiyang, and Yingyang and Interior Minister of Xiangdong, retaining the staff and his general's rank.

sentences.zh: 尋病卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: : Soon he died of illness.

sentences.zh: 後脩靈祐又合餘衆攻篹，篹復敗走豫章，劉希祖亦以郡降。

translations.literal: Later Xiu Lingyou again combined remaining troops to attack Juan; Juan was again defeated and fled to Yuzhang, and Liu Xizu also surrendered the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: : Later Xiu Lingyou again combined remaining troops to attack Juan; Juan was defeated and fled to Yuzhang, and Liu Xizu also surrendered the commandery.

sentences.zh: 湘東內史王僧粲亦拒義，自稱平西將軍、湘州刺史，以南平鎮軍主周敷爲長史，率前軍襲湘州，去州百餘里。

translations.literal: Wang Sengcan, Interior Minister of Xiangdong, also resisted the righteous cause, styled himself General of Pacifying the West and Inspector of Xiang province, made Zhou Fu, army commander of Nanping, his Chief Clerk, and with the van army raided Xiang province, more than a hundred li from the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: : Wang Sengcan, Interior Minister of Xiangdong, also resisted the righteous cause, styled himself General of Pacifying the West and Inspector of Xiang province, made Zhou Fu his Chief Clerk, and with the van army raided Xiang province, coming within a hundred li of the seat.

sentences.zh: 楊公則長史劉坦守州城，遣軍主尹法略拒之，屢戰不勝。

translations.literal: Liu Tan, Chief Clerk to Yang Gongze, held the provincial city and sent army commander Yin Falüe to resist him; repeatedly they fought without victory.
translations.idiomatic: : Liu Tan, Chief Clerk to Yang Gongze, held the provincial city and sent Yin Falüe, army commander, to resist; repeatedly they fought without victory.

sentences.zh: 及聞建康城平，僧粲散走，乃斬之。

translations.literal: When he heard Jiankang city was pacified, Sengcan scattered and fled, and then was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: : When he heard Jiankang had fallen, Sengcan scattered and fled and was then beheaded.

sentences.zh: 南康太守王丹亦爲郡人所殺。

translations.literal: Wang Dan, Administrator of Nankang, was also killed by men of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: : Wang Dan, Administrator of Nankang, was also killed by men of his commandery.

sentences.zh: 郢城降，義師衆軍東下。

translations.literal: When Ying city surrendered, the armies of the righteous cause marched east.
translations.idiomatic: : When Ying city surrendered, the armies of the righteous cause marched east.

sentences.zh: 八月，魯休烈蕭璝破汶陽太守劉孝慶等於峽口，巴東太守任漾之見殺，遂至上明，江陵大震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Lu Xiulie and Xiao Gui defeated Liu Xiaoqing and others at the gorge mouth; Ren Yangzhi was killed, and they then reached Shangming; Jiangling was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: : In the eighth month Lu Xiulie and Xiao Gui defeated Liu Xiaoqing and others at the gorge mouth; Ren Yangzhi was killed, and they advanced to Shangming; Jiangling was greatly shaken.

sentences.zh: 穎冑恐，馳告梁王曰：「劉孝慶爲蕭璝所敗，宜遣楊公則還援根本。

translations.literal: Yingzhou was afraid and sent urgent word to the Prince of Liang: "Liu Xiaoqing was defeated by Xiao Gui; Yang Gongze should be sent back to rescue the root foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzhou, afraid, sent urgent word to the Prince of Liang: "Liu Xiaoqing was defeated by Xiao Gui; Yang Gongze should be sent back to rescue our base.

sentences.zh: 」梁王曰：「公則今泝流上荊，鞭長之義耳。

translations.literal: " The Prince of Liang said: "Gongze is now rowing upstream toward Jing—the meaning of a whip too short.
translations.idiomatic: " The Prince of Liang said: "Gongze is now rowing upstream toward Jing—the whip is too short to reach.

sentences.zh: 蕭璝、魯休烈烏合之衆，尋自退散。

translations.literal: Xiao Gui and Lu Xiulie are a mob gathered together; they will soon withdraw and scatter of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Gui and Lu Xiulie are a mob gathered together; they will soon withdraw of themselves.

sentences.zh: 政須荊州少時持重。

translations.literal: What is needed is only that Jing province hold firm for a little while.
translations.idiomatic: Jing province need only hold firm for a little while.

sentences.zh: 良須兵力，兩弟在雍，指遣往徵，不爲難至。

translations.literal: Troops are truly needed; two younger brothers are in Yong—I will order them to campaign; it is not hard for them to arrive.
translations.idiomatic: We truly need troops; my two younger brothers are in Yong—I will order them to march; they can arrive without difficulty.

sentences.zh: 」穎冑乃追贈任漾之輔國將軍、梁州刺史。

translations.literal: " Yingzhou then posthumously granted Ren Yangzhi General Who Assists the State and Inspector of Liang province.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingzhou then posthumously made Ren Yangzhi General Who Assists the State and Inspector of Liang province.

sentences.zh: 遣軍主蔡道恭假節屯上明拒蕭璝。

translations.literal: Army commander Cai Daogong was sent with lent staff to encamp at Shangming to resist Xiao Gui.
translations.idiomatic: : Army commander Cai Daogong was sent bearing the staff to encamp at Shangming and resist Xiao Gui.

sentences.zh: 時梁王已平郢、江二鎮。

translations.literal: At that time the Prince of Liang had already pacified the Ying and Jiang garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: : At that time the Prince of Liang had already pacified the Ying and Jiang garrisons.

sentences.zh: 穎冑輔帝出居上流，有安重之勢。

translations.literal: Yingzhou assisted the emperor in dwelling in the upper stream and had a position of security and weight.
translations.idiomatic: : Yingzhou assisted the emperor in holding the upper stream and enjoyed a position of security and weight.

sentences.zh: 素能飲酒，噉白肉鱠至三升，旣聞蕭跂等兵相持不決，憂慮感氣，十二月壬寅夜，卒。

translations.literal: He had always been able to drink wine and could eat raw fish sliced in white sauce up to three sheng; when he heard that Xiao Gui and others' armies were locked in stalemate without decision, worry and grief affected his qi, and on the night of renyin in the twelfth month he died.
translations.idiomatic: : He had always been able to drink heavily and could eat up to three sheng of raw fish in white sauce; when he heard Xiao Gui's army was locked in stalemate, worry affected his constitution, and on the night of renyin in the twelfth month he died.

sentences.zh: 遺表曰：「臣疹患數日，不謂便至困篤，氣息綿微，待盡而已。

translations.literal: His final memorial said: "Your servant has suffered rash illness for several days and did not think it would reach such exhaustion; breath is fine and slight—I await the end only.
translations.idiomatic: His final memorial said: "I have suffered this rash illness for days and did not think it would reach such exhaustion; my breath is faint and I await only the end.

sentences.zh: 臣雖庸薄，忝籍葭莩，過受先朝殊常之眷，循寵礪心，誓生以死。

translations.literal: Your servant, though mediocre and slight, humbly shares reed-and-rush kinship and excessively received the former court's exceptional favor; following favor I sharpened my heart and swore life unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Though I am mediocre and slight, I humbly share kinship with the throne and received exceptional favor from the former court; following that favor I sharpened my heart and swore my life to the cause.

sentences.zh: 屬皇業中否，天地分崩，總率諸侯，翼奉明聖。

translations.literal: It fell in an era when the imperial enterprise was mid-way obstructed and Heaven and Earth split apart; I led the feudal lords in total and winged support of the bright sage.
translations.idiomatic: : When the imperial enterprise was obstructed and Heaven and Earth split apart, I led the feudal lords in winged support of the bright sage.

sentences.zh: 賴社稷靈長，大明在運，故兵之所臨，無思不服。

translations.literal: Relying on the altars of state's enduring spirit and great brilliance in the cycle, wherever the army faced none thought but to submit.
translations.idiomatic: : Relying on the enduring spirit of the altars and great brilliance in the cycle, wherever the army faced, none failed to submit.

sentences.zh: 今四海垂平，干戈行戢，方希陪翠華，奉法駕，反東都，觀舊物。

translations.literal: Now the four seas hang toward peace and weapons are being stowed; I was just hoping to accompany the emerald regalia, attend the law chariot, return to the eastern capital, and view the old things.
translations.idiomatic: : Now the four seas lean toward peace and weapons are being stowed; I had hoped to accompany the imperial chariot, return to the eastern capital, and view the old things.

sentences.zh: 不幸遘疾，奄辭明世，懷此深恨，永結泉壤。

translations.literal: Unhappily I encountered illness and suddenly leave the bright age; bearing this deep regret I am forever bound to the springs below.
translations.idiomatic: : Unhappily I have fallen ill and must leave the bright age; bearing this deep regret I am forever bound to the yellow springs.

sentences.zh: 竊惟王業至重，萬機甚大，登之實難，守之未易。

translations.literal: I privately consider that the royal enterprise is supremely heavy and the myriad affairs exceedingly great—to ascend it is truly hard and to guard it not easy.
translations.idiomatic: : I consider that the royal enterprise is supremely heavy and the myriad affairs exceedingly great—to ascend the throne is hard and to guard it is not easy.

sentences.zh: 陛下富於春秋，當遠尋祖宗創業艱難，殷鑒季末顛覆厥緒，思所以念始圖終，康此兆庶。

translations.literal: Your Majesty is rich in spring and autumn; you should far seek how the ancestors founded the enterprise in hardship, take as mirror the overturning of the succession at the age's end, and think how to mind the beginning and plan the end, bringing peace to these millions.
translations.idiomatic: : Your Majesty is still young; you should look far back to how the ancestors founded the enterprise in hardship, take warning from the overturning of the dynasty at the age's end, and think how to mind the beginning and plan the end, bringing peace to the millions.

sentences.zh: 征東大將軍臣衍，元勳上德，光贊天下，陛下垂拱仰成，則風流日化，臣雖萬沒，無所遺恨。

translations.literal: General Who Campaigns East Chen Yan, first in merit and supreme in virtue, gloriously assists All-under-Heaven; if Your Majesty drapes your hands and looks up to his completion, then customs will daily be transformed—I though ten thousand times dead leave no lingering regret.
translations.idiomatic: : General Who Campaigns East Chen Yan, supreme in merit and virtue, gloriously assists the realm; if Your Majesty reigns at ease while he completes the work, customs will be transformed daily—though I die ten thousand times I leave no regret.

sentences.zh: 」時年四十。

translations.literal: " He was aged forty.
translations.idiomatic: : He was forty years old.

sentences.zh: 和帝出臨哭。

translations.literal: Prince He came out to attend the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: : Prince He came out to attend the mourning.

sentences.zh: 詔贈侍中、丞相，本官如故。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted Palace Attendant and Chancellor, his original offices as before.
translations.idiomatic: : An edict posthumously granted him Palace Attendant and Chancellor, his existing posts as before.

sentences.zh: 前後部羽葆鼓吹，班劔三十人。

translations.literal: Front and rear guard feather-canopy martial music, thirty halberd-bearers.
translations.idiomatic: : Front and rear guard feather-canopy martial music and thirty halberd-bearers.

sentences.zh: 轀輬車，黃屋左纛。

translations.literal: The bier carriage, yellow canopy and left banner.
translations.idiomatic: : A bier carriage with yellow canopy and left banner.

sentences.zh: 梁王圍建康城，住在石頭，和帝密詔報穎冑凶問，祕不發喪。

translations.literal: The Prince of Liang besieged Jiankang city and dwelt at Stone City; Prince He by secret edict reported Yingzhou's news of death, and mourning was concealed without being proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: : The Prince of Liang besieged Jiankang and dwelt at Stone City; Prince He by secret edict reported Yingzhou's death, and mourning was concealed.

sentences.zh: 及城平，識者聞之，知天命之有在矣。

translations.literal: When the city was pacified, those who knew of it understood that the Mandate of Heaven had its place.
translations.idiomatic: : When the city fell, those who knew of it understood that the Mandate of Heaven had found its place.

sentences.zh: 梁，詔曰：「念功惟德，歷代所同，追遠懷人，彌與事篤。

translations.literal: Liang—an edict said: "To recall achievement is virtue; through the generations it is the same. To reach back in time and cherish men is ever more bound to the affair's depth.
translations.idiomatic: : Liang—an edict said: "To recall merit is virtue, the same through the ages; to reach back and cherish the dead binds one ever more deeply to the task.

sentences.zh: 齊故侍中、丞相、尚書令穎冑，風格峻遠，器宇淵邵，清猷盛業，問望斯歸。

translations.literal: Former Qi Palace Attendant, Chancellor, and Minister Over the Masters of Writing Yingzhou—his bearing was stern and far-reaching, his capacity deep and vast, his pure plans and flourishing enterprise, his reputation and gaze turned homeward.
translations.idiomatic: : Former Qi Palace Attendant, Chancellor, and Minister Over the Masters of Writing Yingzhou—his bearing was stern and far-reaching, his capacity deep and vast; his pure counsel and flourishing work won the world's regard.

sentences.zh: 締構義始，肇基王迹，挈闊屯夷，載形心事。

translations.literal: He joined the righteous beginning and founded the king's traces; he carried hardship through danger and difficulty and bore his intent in deeds and heart.
translations.idiomatic: : He joined the righteous beginning and founded the royal enterprise; he bore hardship through danger and carried his intent in deed and heart.

sentences.zh: 朕膺天改命，光宅區宇，望岱瞻河，永言增慟。

translations.literal: I have received Heaven's command to change destiny and brightly dwell in the realm; gazing at Mount Tai and the Yellow River, I speak forever of increased grief.
translations.idiomatic: : I have received Heaven's command and brightly dwell in the realm; gazing at Mount Tai and the River, my grief only deepens.

sentences.zh: 可封巴東郡公，邑三千戶，本官如故。

translations.literal: He may be enfeoffed as Duke of Badong commandery with a fief of three thousand households, his original offices as before.
translations.idiomatic: : Let him be enfeoffed as Duke of Badong commandery with a fief of three thousand households, his existing posts as before.

sentences.zh: 」喪還，今上車駕臨哭渚次。

translations.literal: " When the coffin returned, the present emperor's imperial carriage came to mourn at the ferry station.
translations.idiomatic: : When the coffin returned, the present emperor's carriage came to mourn at the ferry station.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「齊故侍中、丞相、尚書令穎冑葬送有期，前代所加殊禮，依晉王導、齊豫章王故事，可悉給。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Former Qi Palace Attendant, Chancellor, and Minister Over the Masters of Writing Yingzhou's burial and escort have a set date; the special rites added by former ages—following the precedents of Wang Dao of Jin and the Prince of Yuzhang of Qi—may all be granted.
translations.idiomatic: : An edict said: "Former Qi Palace Attendant, Chancellor, and Minister Over the Masters of Writing Yingzhou's burial has a set date; the special rites of former ages—following Wang Dao of Jin and the Prince of Yuzhang of Qi—may all be granted.

sentences.zh: 諡曰獻武。

translations.literal: Posthumous title: Presented Martial.
translations.idiomatic: : His posthumous title shall be Presented Martial.

sentences.zh: 」范僧簡贈交州刺史。

translations.literal: " Fan Jian was posthumously granted Inspector of Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: : Fan Jian was posthumously made Inspector of Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 【史論】

translations.literal: Historiographical Comment
translations.idiomatic: Historiographical Comment

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：魏氏基於用武，夏侯諸曹，竝以戚族而爲將相。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: The Wei house was founded on the use of martial force; the Xiahou and Cao clans all became generals and chancellors through kinship.
translations.idiomatic: : The historiographer says: The Wei house was founded on martial force; the Xiahou and Cao clans all became generals and chancellors through kinship.

sentences.zh: 夫股肱爲義，旣有常然，肺腑之重，兼存宗寄。

translations.literal: That arms and legs serve righteousness has its constant reason; the weight of heart and lungs also bears imperial entrustment.
translations.idiomatic: : That arms and legs serve the cause has its constant reason; the weight of the inner circle also bears imperial trust.

sentences.zh: 豐沛之閒，貴人滿市，功臣所出，多在南陽。

translations.literal: Between Feng and Pei, honored men filled the markets; those from whom the merit ministers came were mostly from Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: : Between Feng and Pei honored men filled the markets; most of the founding ministers came from Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 夫貞幹所以成務，非虛言也。

translations.literal: Upright trunk is how achievement is accomplished—this is no empty saying.
translations.idiomatic: : Upright trunk is how achievement is accomplished—this is no empty saying.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：新吳事武，簡在帝心。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Xinwu served the martial cause, chosen in the emperor's heart.
translations.idiomatic: : The encomium says: Xinwu served the martial cause, chosen in the emperor's heart.

sentences.zh: 南豐治政，迹顯亡衾。

translations.literal: Nanfeng governed with integrity; his traces shine though he lacked a quilt.
translations.idiomatic: : Nanfeng governed with integrity; his traces shine though he died without a quilt.

sentences.zh: 鎮軍茂績，機識弘深，荊南立主，嚮義漢陰。

translations.literal: The Pacifying Army's abundant achievement, judgment and insight broad and deep—he established the lord in southern Jing and turned righteousness toward the Han shore.
translations.idiomatic: : The Pacifying Army's abundant achievement and broad, deep judgment—he established the lord in southern Jing and turned righteousness toward the Han shore.
